message.subject: Collaboration with EDXSO
message.email_body: Are you exploring how AI tools can be applied in schools? Your video on the Airbyte AI Agent caught our attention. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth. We want to propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This gives your audience teachers and school decision makers an educational resource about practical technology in schools. Would you be open to a brief conversation?
